test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

In the next few months, / they will / have teach / hundreds of children.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb.
 
• The phrase "have teach" should be corrected to "have to teach" or "will teach".
 
• The correct phrase should be "they will have to teach", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In the next few months, they will have to teach hundreds of children."*
